description: This source file defines the AggregatedQueueFlowController class, which implements the IQueueFlowController interface by aggregating multiple other IQueueFlowController instances. The class provides a constructor to set a default maximum add count and a method to compute the minimum max add count across its contained controllers.

classes.name: AggregatedQueueFlowController
classes.description: A class that aggregates multiple IQueueFlowController instances and exposes a combined interface.

methods.name: AggregatedQueueFlowController
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the controller with a default maximum add count.

methods.name: GetMaxAddCount
methods.description: Computes the minimum maximum add count among all contained controllers, or returns the default maximum if no controllers are present.
